# I measure, evaluate and analyze data to improve education and social programs.

::: lede
I'm a psychologist and a measurement, evaluation and data specialist with over 5 years of experience in social and education programs. I've led [quasi-experimental evaluations](about.qmd#experience) across Latin America, I build [courses and tools](projects/index.qmd) for analyzing data with R and Python, and I share what I learn on the [blog](blog/index.qmd).
:::
